## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] Full applicable nf-core pipeline, local-module and subworkflow lint passes.
- [ ] Scientific changes match the selected public R package, including complete-family correction and RNG.
- [ ] Real relevant nf-test/direct-R workflows pass; skipped/unrun engines and scale are explicit.
- [ ] Usage/output/citations and source/runtime provenance are current.
- [ ] No private data, credentials, altered historical receipts or silent scientific fallback.

Target the active development branch. Release/merge requires maintainer authorization.
